notes.title: 1.1.0 version released. Enjoy new 3D 4 levels! and happy new year
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29358217/c79510361478f1f90636150e423c0b257443f117.png[/img]
1.1.0 Updates :
Exter level "2018" is added.(4 levels are included)
Extra levels do not use save system, but only checkpoint system.

Previous version save data could be not working on 1.1.0
On beta option, you can choose previous versions.

notes.title: 1.0.1 version is released and about trading cards
notes.content:
[1.0.1 patch notes]

Now only true ending exists, normal ending is deleted.
Added more savepoints

--

1.0.0 save data could not be work on 1.0.1.
If you have problems, try 1.0.0 version.


[About trading cards]
Maybe steam will not allow trading cards on this game, so I removed "Trading cards system" on shop. (Displaying "Trading cards system" on shop was also steam glitch)

If you bought this game to collect trading cards, request refund to steam.
When steam do not accept, please contact me.
